description: Adds one person to a live targeted campaign and returns their personal link, or emails it from clearvoyance.ai when send is true (sandbox accounts never send). One call per order, ticket or sign-up. Pass an email, or your own externalId when you will deliver the link yourself. One person, one link: the same person twice is refused. Refused with 402 once the campaign has as many invitations as it paid for (cohortSize at launch); launch another for the next group.

apiKey.description: Your Clearvoyance API key (cv_live_… or cv_test_…), from create_account

campaignId.description: A campaign id from launch_campaign or list_my_campaigns

externalId.description: Your own id for them (order, ticket, customer) instead of an email.

send.description: true: we email the invitation. Default false: the link comes back to you.

name: invite_person
title: Invite one person
